caption: The drawing depicts a stylized rooster figurine. The rooster's body is primarily a beige or off-white color, with a red comb and wattle on its head. The beak is black, and the eye is depicted as a small, circular black spot. Its wing is painted green with some black lines detailing, and the base of the figurine is painted with two bands of color—green on top and red on the bottom. The tail is large and fan-shaped, sharing the beige body color with four bold, curved black lines for emphasis, and the tip of the tail has a small area of red. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, accentuating the figure without distractions.
title: Chalkware Rooster
